features: Karaoke is stronger: turning it on removes the vocals for an instrumental-style mix and opens Cinema lyrics in English letters
Play Next list now uses the same liquid glass as the Home navigation bar, dark and clear instead of white
New round liquid like and download buttons in Now Playing, with a liquid ripple and droplet animation when you like a song
Music Cube now sits at the top of Home and shows songs from your chosen music language; pick your own 6 songs in Settings > Appearance > Immersive > Music Cube
Player background is now the first option in the player's three-dot menu
Ambience button is centred under the player controls
Hidden player thumbnail now shows the Pattukal app icon
SponsorBlock auto-skip is on by default
bug_fixes: Removed the outline lines around player and Play Next buttons
Luna and Kai companion faces are sharper (re-rendered at 4x resolution)
